assets.prompt: Create an animation sprite sheet of the EXACT employee from image 1. Image 1 is identity/face/hair/clothing/colors reference: preserve all details and compact proportions, no redesign. Image 2 is ONLY the player's walking pose and direction reference, NOT identity or clothing. Required view throughout: BACK view facing straight away. Crisp clean pixel art with dark outlines and simple broad shadow clusters matching image 1, not painted. TRANSPARENT background, no labels, no grid lines. EXACTLY 12 complete isolated figures in an evenly spaced 4 columns by 3 rows grid, row-major order, each same scale, same head proportions and generous empty gaps; no cropped feet/hair. First row plus second row = 8-frame walk loop: frame 1 left foot forward/right back contact, 2 left leg supports/right passes, 3 right foot advancing, 4 right contact, 5 right supports/left back, 6 left passes, 7 left foot advancing, 8 just before left contact to loop into 1. Arms counter-swing naturally, physical left/right legs must alternate, small consistent body bob, empty hands. Pose examples in image 2 guide stride, but keep the exact employee from image 1. Third row = 4-frame calm standing IDLE breathing loop in the SAME required direction: both feet planted unchanged, hands relaxed, frame9 neutral, frame10 gentle inhale shoulders 1 pixel higher, frame11 small peak inhale, frame12 gentle exhale toward neutral. No walking in idle row. Keep head dimensions and costume identical across all 12 figures. No large pose jumps, duplicated half cycles, exaggerated breathing, props or scene.
